description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the OEM Suzuki Samurai JA Model, Driver’s and Passenger’s Front Seats plus Headrests. TILT MECHANISMS NOT INCLUDED.
These are NOT COVERS but rather the COVERS/FRAMES & CUSHIONS plus HEADRESTS for the Driver Side & Passenger Side.
All you will need to do is to remove your existing seats and take off the seat slides and seat recline mechanisms and bolt directly on to these.
These seats are Suzuki OEM seats so your parts will fit perfectly on these seats; no drilling, no cutting, no cussing, just bolts right up.
The seat color pattern is a light color that is designed to reflect the suns heat giving you a cooler seat in the summer, especially when the tops off.
These seats are made from heavy, durable pressed vinyl and have an off-white patterned seating area and a dark gray side and back.
These will fit in both JL and JX models.
If you need seat slides we have them under the “Interior” category.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Seat Bottom Cushion – Driver’s Side
Qty 1 – Seat Back Cushion – Driver’s Side
Qty 1 – Headrest – Driver’s Side
Qty 1 – Seat Bottom Cushion – Passenger’s Side
Qty 1 – Seat Back Cushion – Passenger’s Side
Qty 1 – Headrest – Passenger’s Side
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
